name: sidekick
description: A cute desktop mascot that runs on your own Claude Code
author: sang-ute

scripts.lint: npm run lint:ui && npm run lint:rust
scripts.lint:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets --features test-support -- -D warnings
scripts.test: npm run test:ui && npm run test:rust
scripts.e2e:build: npm run vite:build && cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --features tauri/custom-protocol,test-support
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run e2e:build && npm run e2e
